description: Find document records by title, publication contributor, supported date or matching passage text. Returns metadata and identifiers rather than document text. Omit filters to browse records.

content_query.description: Keep documents containing a passage that matches all supplied terms. Accepts 1–64 searchable terms.
content_query.title: Content Query

cursor.description: Continue from a returned next_cursor, keeping all other arguments unchanged.
cursor.title: Cursor

date_from.description: Inclusive lower bound for supported document dates, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Month-only date ranges are separate metadata and are excluded from exact date filtering.
date_from.title: Date From

date_status.description: Select documents whose date is supported, unknown or ambiguous.
date_status.title: Date Status

date_to.description: Inclusive upper bound for supported document dates, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Month-only ranges do not establish an exact day.
date_to.title: Date To

document_type.description: Filter by the exact recorded document type.
document_type.title: Document Type

limit.description: Maximum documents per page, from 1 to 20.
limit.title: Limit

order.description: Sort by title or ascending document_date. Date ordering places unknown or ambiguous dates last.
order.title: Order

query.description: Find titles containing all supplied terms after normalization. Accepts 1–16 terms and supports partial-word matches. Example: Hidden Words.
query.title: Query

responsibility.description: Filter by a publication contributor in any recorded role, such as author, issuer, compiler or translator. Accepts a name, recognized alias or contributor ID. Name matching normalizes case, punctuation and diacritics; Bahaullah matches Bahá’u’lláh.
responsibility.title: Responsibility

name: find_documents
